nodes.label: Missing Pull Request Template
nodes.rationale: Until a template exists, describe each change and classify it as refactoring or re-engineering in the PR body.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Startup Gate
nodes.rationale: Runs first, before reading other documents, so the graph can help navigate them; stale graphs are reported rather than treated as current.

nodes.label: Local Graph Policy
nodes.rationale: Graph exists; workflow guide applies without separate approval; follows the artifact-tracking baseline with core artifacts committed and local-only files gitignored.

nodes.label: Canonical Home of Shared Rules
nodes.rationale: Repository files such as .copilotignore and the agent context are baselines consuming 8fold projects start from.

nodes.label: Information Hierarchy External Link
nodes.rationale: Links to site-masteringthemundane.com at bc4f99d until this package ships its own copy.

nodes.label: Mid-consolidation State
nodes.rationale: composer check is not expected to pass: unparsable files in src/Attributes and a missing rule registered in extension.neon; do not fix unrelated code.

nodes.label: Non-functional Commands (composer local, graph:refresh)
nodes.rationale: composer local description is aspirational; graph:refresh calls a missing cli/graphify-token-usage.php.

nodes.label: Unmeasured Token Usage Correction
nodes.rationale: Zero semantic-extraction tokens that were not measured misrepresent usage; a code-only extraction can legitimately record zero.

nodes.label: Voice Rule (Copy)
nodes.rationale: Copied from AGENTS.md, the canonical source, so the rule survives context resets; both must change together.

nodes.label: Enforcement Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Only PHPCS, PHPStan, and PHPUnit via composer check:* are enforced; AGENTS.md guidance is not unless a tool implements it.
